verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch Community Edition is explicitly MIT-licensed and its source is publicly hosted on GitHub, satisfying the 'read source under open license' story. Community discussion notes an open-core model where some enterprise features (SSO, audit logs) are proprietary and gated, but this doesn't negate the openly licensed core codebase. Missing for 10: no independent audit confirming full parity between GitHub source and hosted product, and some contributed features are reportedly withheld from OSS to protect enterprise tier.
